profile.headline: Agentic Engineering
profile.summary:
• I am a strategic, driven, and focused professional with a seasoned software engineering background, a history of managing multi-million-dollar development projects, and a talent for aligning teams around common goals. I combine over 14 years’ experience providing software engineering leadership, oversight, and direction for multiple high-profile organizations; developing leading-edge applications, products, and solutions that resolve key business and technical challenges; leading a suite of projects and strategic initiatives to deliver seamless end-user experiences; and carefully shaping the processes and policies that sustain an efficient, productive, and highly competitive organization.

• I am a supportive team leader with a strong ability to take charge of projects, train and empower others, and motivate those around me to do their best work. I believe a leader’s primary duty is to cultivate, professionally develop, and inspire his team. I have the ability, expertise, and coaching skills to drive my team to success.

• I have the communication skills to clearly articulate my vision, persuade people to take action, and get the ball rolling in the right direction. Whether I’m sending out emails, communicating with a team member, presenting to a crowd, or anything in between; I communicate quickly, accurately, and effectively.

• I am an agile thinker who is highly adaptable and quick on his feet. In today’s rapidly evolving software engineering space, what worked yesterday may not work tomorrow. I have the experience and the dexterity to stay one step ahead of change, shift gears when the context calls for it, respond effectively to evolving industry trends, and drive my organization to success.

positions.title: Solution Lead at Paychex Inc.
positions.description:
As Solution Lead, I am accountable for leading a 6-member development team to continually improve Paychex’s Retirement and OEP Programs.

To carry out my mandate, I oversee solution design, development, research, architecture, coding, and testing efforts to deliver high-quality, secure technical solutions in a scaled agile environment.

I also meet with Paychex developers, architects, and product managers to align strategies, assess project feasibility, define risk, drive project planning efforts, and provide recommendations for project adjustments.

Some of my key contributions include:

• Evaluate team member coding to ensure its quality and integrity. 
• Manage 2-3 concurrent projects with budgets up to $1.2MM each.
• Completed 11 projects, ensuring 100% compliance with schedules and budgets.
• Implemented a PI planning-based approach to accurately plan and estimate projects.
• Partner with DevOps to integrate CI/CD principles throughout the software development process.
• Mentor developers to close knowledge/skill gaps and elevate team performance.
• Connect the agile team with internal experts to identify and address technical obstacles.

positions.title: Principal/Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
Between 2019 and 2021, I led a -member engineering team to integrate third-party cybersecurity products into Digital Defense frontline applications. 

I served as Scrum Master, leading efforts to estimate project schedules and budgets, facilitate agile ceremonies, and uphold scrum methodologies and agile best practices.

Some of my contributions include:

• Managed up to 3 projects concurrently, executing in as little as 2-3 months.
• Integrated Frontline VM API and third-party software using python, bottle, AWS Lambda, and AWS DynamoDb.
• Designed an architecture to standardize all integration efforts.
• Implemented scrum, a branching strategy, code reviews, and integration/unit testing to standardize the SDLC.
• Created project estimates.
• Orchestrated product requirements gathering, definition, and analysis efforts.
• Produced Product Backlog Items (PBIs) to support projects.
• Provided feedback and recommendations in new vendor products to the CTO and CEO.
• Trained developers in software engineering best practices.
• Deployed a Malware Machine Learning (ML) predictor using AWS SageMaker and Anaconda.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer at Paychex, Inc.
positions.description:
I joined Mindex in 2018, where I orchestrated the integration of Paychex’s main platform with external job sites over a 9-month period.

I drove project planning and scheduling efforts, supporting the development and testing teams by reviewing code and providing feedback to improve code quality.

Some of my additional contributions include:

• Integrated Paychex Flex HR Center with Indeed.com, resulting in automated job posting capabilities.
• Drove the development and release of Paychex’s first software product in one fiscal quarter.
• Developed notifications for performance management reviews, creating a .NET library to handle Razr files as email templates. 
• Mentored team members in TAF Automation testing, complex requirements, and other technical skills such as code designs, jasmine tests, and AngularJS features.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Rochester, New York Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
As Senior Software Engineer, I was responsible for supporting and continually improving a Provider Portal used by doctors and hospitals. 

I spearheaded a redesign of core components to enhance the Provider Portal by adding new authorization forms and integrating it with Facets and other data sources.

Some of my additional contributions include:

• Uncovered high-risk security vulnerabilities, mobilizing the team to fix security gaps or deficiencies. Contributed millions of dollars in potentially avoided costs by addressing security vulnerabilities.
• Trained team members in best practices of software design, performance bottlenecks, and jQuery.
• Participated in scrum ceremonies and continually upheld the scrum framework.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
In 2016, I was selected by previous managers to manage 3 integration projects and develop 3 websites for 4 clients.

I analyzed requirements for third-party API integrations, produced time and budget estimates for all integration projects, and installed and configured GRAV CMS.

I also integrated Poynt API, Caliber API, and Sage50UK desktop with a custom messaging platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Between 2014 and 2016, I drove software engineering efforts to continually improve internal applications and payment platforms. 

I transformed client applications into mobile-friendly versions and integrated the main application with the payment platform.

I also implemented unit testing for new projects and trained team members in unit testing processes.

Some of my additional contributions include:

• Developed the mobile version of the Customer Invoice Payment flow using jQuery Mobile, C#, and .NET Webforms.
• Supported, fixed, and optimized backend multi-threaded jobs which were used to import invoice data from multiple sources, parse data from PDF files, schedule recurring transactions, and import payment information from diverse sources.
• Partnered with the Product Committee to analyze requirements and define work activities.
